ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory negative screening of all UBOs, incorporators, signatories and the resident agent against the OFAC SDN List, the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and Panama's UAF/ISNF domestic PEP and sanctions databases before engagement; continuous re-screening every 90 calendar days; PEPs trigger enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and documented source-of-funds verification. Given the standard low-risk classification of the tabletop-gaming accessories business and the Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal payment rails, simplified due diligence is permissible under Law 23 of 2015, but no screening waiver is available.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Sistema de Consulta y Reserva de Nombres de Sociedades (Mercantile Section; online platform via https://www.registropublico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressible in Latin script; Spanish is the default registry language. Foreign-language or invented names are admissible only if phonetically representable in Spanish and if no phonetic conflict with an existing registered name exists; a Spanish-language version or a meaningful Spanish translation should be inserted in the deed. Purely ideographic or logographic names are unacceptable.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: FIDUCIARIA / TRUST / FONDO / FONDO DE INVERSIÓN
FINANCIERA / EMPRESA DE REMESAS / CASA DE CAMBIO
NACIONAL / PRESIDENCIAL / OFICIAL (where state connotation may arise)
INTERNACIONAL (only where combined with a state or international-organization identity)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may immediately file an alternative name through the same online registry channel. The rejection determination may be contested within five working days by filing a Recurso de Reconsideración before the Director General of the Registro Público, attaching a phonetic and dissociation comparison table against the cited conflicting names. If the reconsideration is denied, administrative remedies are exhausted and the matter may be appealed to the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo of the Corte Suprema de Justicia within two months. The initial 30-day reservation is not extendable; upon lapse, the same name may be re-filed if no third party has reserved or registered it in the interim.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted under Panamanian law: the statutory registered office may lawfully be the office address of the licensed resident agent. No factory, warehouse, or physical shop in Panama is required for the micro-manufacturing of handcrafted tabletop dice; the atelier may remain in the founder's home jurisdiction while the S.A. is domiciled at the resident agent's registered address in Panama.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 3% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection during the first financial year; Panama's UAF/ISNF inspection priority is concentrated on regulated financial and fiduciary service providers, not on low-risk goods merchants). On-site verification by the resident agent's own compliance function is reasonably expected solely for document-keeping confirmation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (General Corporation Law of Panama), as amended, Arts. 1-10 (incorporation, authorized capital, share subscription), Art. 33 (resident agent), Arts. 44-50 (directors and officers); supplemented by Cabinet Decree No. 3 of 1937 and by Law 5 of 2019 (beneficial ownership and corporate transparency obligations)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Public Registry of Panama, Legal Entities / Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (Notarized Public Deed of Incorporation) registered under a Ficha Mercantil in the Public Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Law 32 of 1927, Art. 1 - minimum authorized capital of USD 10,000; however, no minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit are required at formation. The first board may subscribe and issue shares against partial payment or in-kind consideration valued by the directors; at least one share must be subscribed before registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the subscription of one common share of the authorized capital for each subscriber, issued as fully paid non-assessable shares, as reflected in the Share Subscription and Issuance Ledger. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation in Panama is established at [Street Address], Panama City, Republic of Panama, and that [Resident Agent Name], a licensed resident agent, is appointed as statutory agent for service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is elected President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, each for the statutory term, with full powers to open banking accounts, execute commercial contracts, register the RUC and municipal permit, and carry out the manufacture and sale of polyhedral gaming dice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Ventanilla de Denominaciones (Denominations Window) or online through the Registro Público digital platform (Renova)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written or online request for a denomination search for a Sociedad Anónima, proposing three optional corporate names in descending order and stating the intended purpose. Pay the search fee and obtain the Certificado de Búsqueda y Reserva de Denominación, which reserves the approved name for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Formulario de Búsqueda de Denominación (completed name-search form)
Copy of passport or cédula of each incorporator
Brief statement of corporate purpose (ISIC 3240 manufacturing scope)
Proof of payment of the name-search and reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused because it is identical or confusingly similar to an existing registration, the incorporators may immediately file a new search with alternate names without additional statutory penalty; if an existing holder objects, the Registry marks the conflicting name unavailable, and the incorporators proceed with a revised name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito (Notary Public of the Judicial Circuit, commonly the 1st Circuit of Panamá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The attorney drafts the Escritura Pública including corporate name, purpose (manufacture and sale of handmade polyhedral epoxy-resin gaming dice and tabletop accessories), authorized capital of at least USD 10,000, share classes, registered office, resident agent clause, first directors and duration. Subscribers appear before the Notary personally or by authenticated power of attorney to execute the deed; fiscal stamps are pre-purchased from the Banco Nacional de Panamá and protocolized with the deed.
required_dossiers: Draft public deed in the Spanish language
Passport or cédula copies of all subscribers
Certificado de Búsqueda y Reserva de Denominación (valid reservation)
Authenticated power of attorney with apostille (if incorporators act by attorney)
Signed acceptance letter of the licensed resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary or the client identifies a drafting error, the deed is amended and re-executed before the same Notary prior to protocolization, with no re-filing penalty; if a notarial jurisdiction challenge arises, the deed is re-executed before a notary of the correct circuit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Corporate Deed in the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Legal Entities / Mercantile Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the protocolized deed together with the Mercantile registration request at the Legal Entities Section. The Registry verifies corporate name, capital, purpose, resident agent appointment and validity of first directors. Upon approval, it inscribes the corporation, allocates a Ficha (corporate docket) and issues the Certificado de Registro, which evidences legal existence and limited liability.
required_dossiers: Protocolized Escritura Pública plus two first-copy certified copies
Mercantile registration cover sheet (solicitud de inscripción)
Receipt of fiscal stamp and registration fee payment
Acceptance and qualification certificate of the resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an interim observation (requerimiento) is raised on capital or purpose clauses, counsel files a corrective amended deed or a clarifying petition within the curing period set by the Registry; if registration is denied, an appeal (reconsideración) may be lodged before the Director General of the Public Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of the First Board Resolution and Appointment of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered directors acting at the registered office under Law 32 of 1927; corporate secretary records the minutes in the statutory minute book
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding directors hold their first meeting or execute unanimous written consent adopting the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution: acceptance of share subscriptions and issuance, adoption of the registered office and statutory books, and election of the President, Secretary and Treasurer. The minutes are signed and entered in the corporate minute book; the officers then obtain the corporate kit and proceed with bank account opening, RUC registration and physical licensing.
required_dossiers: Pro-Forma First Board Resolution (minutes or written consent)
Director acceptance of office forms
Share ledger and share certificate stubs
Notarized extract of minutes if protocolization is requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director is unavailable for quorum, the incorporators ratify the act by unanimous written consent under Art. 44 of Law 32 of 1927; if the minute book is lost or defective, a new protocolized book is opened and a corrective notation is filed at the Public Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration (RUC) and Municipal Operating Permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (e-Tax digital portal); Municipio de Panamá - Dirección de Rentas Municipales (Alcaldía)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following Public Registry inscription, request the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) by filing the registration form with the certified corporate certificate, officers' identification and registered domicile; obtain the RUC certificate. Then file for the municipal Aviso de Operación with the Alcaldía, declaring the workshop address, the epoxy-resin dice and gaming accessories product line, and estimated monthly gross revenue; pay the applicable municipal tax and display the issued Aviso de Operación Municipal at the premises.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Registro de la Sociedad Anónima (certified copy)
Public Registry Ficha copy
Passport or cédula copies of legal representatives
DGI registration form (Formulario de Registro RUC)
Lease agreement or title deed of the workshop premises
Municipal application form and declared revenue estimate for the Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI requests fiscal-domicile verification, submit the lease, a municipal receipt and a notarized domicile declaration; if the municipality objects to the declared activity category or revenue estimate, file a reconsideration petition with the Municipal Director of Revenues within 5 business days supported by sales projections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial, Environmental and Fire-Safety Physical Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental; Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá - Departamento de Prevención y Seguridad; Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) for occupational registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Category I Environmental Registration with MiAMBIENTE describing the epoxy-resin casting process, the chemical inventory (liquid resins, hardeners, acetone cleaning agents) and the proposed waste and emission controls; obtain the environmental resolution. Simultaneously request a fire-risk inspection of the workshop, remedy any deficiencies and obtain the Fire Safety Operating Permit; register the workshop with MITRADEL and enroll workers with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) for occupational-risk coverage.
required_dossiers: Category I Environmental Registration form and process description
Chemical inventory with Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
Workshop floor plan and Uso de Suelo (land-use certificate)
Cuerpo de Bomberos inspection application and floor plan
Civil liability or workplace-risk insurance policy with CSS-affiliated worker register
Municipal Aviso de Operación (previously issued)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MiAMBIENTE issues a technical information requirement, submit the requested risk-assessment supplement within 10 working days; if the fire inspection identifies non-conformities, remedy them and request a free reinspection within 60 days; environmental registration disputes are appealable through the MiAMBIENTE administrative chamber.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipio de Panamá (Alcaldía del Distrito de Panamá) - Dirección de Rentas Municipales as issuing authority for the Aviso de Operación Municipal; Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) for environmental registration; Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá for fire safety; Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) as the institutional registrar of industrial activity
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación Municipal (Municipal Business Operating Notice) complemented by the MiAMBIENTE Environmental Registration (Registro Ambiental Categoría I) and the Cuerpo de Bomberos Fire Safety Operating Permit

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I (Informe de Categoría I / Environmental Registration) under Law 41 of 1998 and Executive Decree No. 123 of 2009 regulating the National Environmental Impact Assessment System; the small-scale handmade dice casting workshop is below the threshold for a full EIA study and is subject to registration-based environmental compliance
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater effluent from resin cleaning and rinsing must comply with Executive Decree No. 75 of 2000 discharge parameters (pH 6-9, BOD5 max 100 mg/L, COD max 200 mg/L, TSS max 100 mg/L); workplace VOC exposure must respect ACGIH TLV-TWA limits (e.g., acetone 250 ppm, styrene 20 ppm, amine hardeners 10 ppm) with local exhaust ventilation; epoxy sludge, contaminated rags and chemical residues must be segregated, labeled and transferred to an authorized hazardous-waste handler under Law 7 of 1986.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Operating Permit from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (site inspection, extinguisher placement, flame-retardant storage of resins and solvents away from ignition sources); structural clearance and Uso de Suelo land-use certificate from the Municipality; workplace clearance through the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) requiring employer registration of workers with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) and compliance with occupational risk-prevention regulations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; official tax filing and e-services portal: Sede Electrónica DGI (https://sede.dgi.gob.pa).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must appoint a Panamanian resident fiscal representative and apply to the DGI for a RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente). The application is submitted through a licensed certified public accountant using Form DGI-102 with corporate formation documents apostilled, certificate of the registered legal agent, proof of local fiscal domicile, a certified copy of the bylaws, and identity documents of directors and the resident fiscal representative. The RUC is the unified taxpayer identification number for both income tax and ITBMS purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid mismatch fiscal classification election. A Panama Sociedad Anónima is by law a separate entity-level corporate taxpayer. Available elections include the optional simplified income tax regime (Régimen Opcional Simplificado del ISR) for small taxpayers, the optional simplified ITBMS margin regime for micro-businesses, and the possibility of advance pricing agreements or tax rulings in transfer-pricing matters. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized under Panamanian tax law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) — Panama's VAT-equivalent transfer tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general monetary threshold: any natural or juridical person engaged in taxable activities or making imports in Panama must obtain a RUC and register for ITBMS. A simplified optional ITBMS/ISR regime applies to small taxpayers with annual gross income up to approximately B/.36,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing has been phased in under DGI Resolution No. 201-1705 of 2019, as amended. Authorized taxpayers must issue electronic tax documents with a digital fiscal stamp, transmit transaction data to the DGI validation platform, and use DGI-authorised ITBMS controls. Processing of e-invoices through the DGI 'Sede Electrónica' system is required for medium and large taxpayers, while taxpayers under the simplified regime may continue to issue pre-printed or simplified electronic documents subject to serialized control. Real-time fiscal clearance and API integration obligations apply to taxpayers enrolled in the DGI e-invoicing programme.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods qualifying as definitive exports from Panama are zero-rated for ITBMS. Exported services are zero-rated when the recipient is a non-resident and the service is wholly performed abroad or not deemed to be sourced in Panama under territorial sourcing rules. The taxpayer must demonstrate physical departure of goods, delivery of offshore services, and receipt of payment from outside Panama. Input ITBMS attributable to zero-rated exports may be recovered as tax credit subject to DGI verification.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación/Documento Único de Exportación)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Panama
Packing list and certificate of origin where applicable
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank transfer/foreign payment evidence
Contract or purchase order evidencing the foreign buyer
ITBMS export refund application form and prior-month input tax credit documentation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Panama does not maintain exchange controls, but DGI practice and export substantiation require that export proceeds be reflected in Panamanian banking records within 180 days of the invoice date. False or unsupported zero-rating claims trigger reassessment of ITBMS at 7% plus surcharges, default interest, reduced-up to 100% penalties, and cancellation of RUC for fiscal fraud. Tax fraud may additionally constitute a criminal offense under Articles 707-717 of the Panama Tax Code, with fines and imprisonment for responsible officers and representatives. Export-related records must be retained for no less than 7 years for audit purposes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP). Panama has no central bank; the Banco Nacional de Panamá acts only as fiscal agent of the State without monetary policy powers. The U.S. dollar is full legal tender and the Balboa (PAB) is a 1:1 unit of account issued only as coins.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Both current and capital account operations are fully convertible with zero FX licensing or approval hurdles. Profit remittance faces no exchange-control barrier; however, banks will require proof of the underlying dividend, a valid tax clearance certificate (Paz y Salvo), and the payment of the Panamanian dividend withholding tax (5% of taxable-source profits or 10% of non-taxed-source profits) before wiring funds abroad. No prior central bank filing is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None apply. Panama imposes no surrender, repatriation, or conversion quota on export proceeds. The PA_CORP S.A. may retain 100% of USD export sale proceeds in any SBP-licensed bank. The only administrative obligation is a customs export declaration through the National Customs Authority (Aduanas / SIGA-VUCEA) and standard commercial documentation (invoice, packing list, bill of lading/courier airway bill).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account in USD (checking plus merchant settlement)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC International Bank, Inc. (BAC Credomatic Panama)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account in USD with integrated e-commerce processor onboarding
Capital Escrow Account for non-resident-invested S.A. structures
Operational Account in USD (longer AML review; lower priority)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW-MEDIUM. Panama does not grant standalone e-money institution (EMI) licenses; any payment institution holding customer funds must be supervised by the SBP under Law 23/2015 (AML/CFT). Global digital EMIs (Wise, Revolut, Airwallex, Mercury) do not issue Panamanian-prefixed virtual account numbers nor local USD routing through SBP-regulated entities. For this project, Kickstarter, Stripe, and PayPal must be integrated as collection-and-disbursement gateways, with final treasury settlement always occurring through a Panama-licensed commercial bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physically mandatory for most Tier-1 institutions. At least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) must attend an in-person KYC interview at the Panamanian branch; fully remote onboarding is accepted only in exceptional low-risk cases with apostilled documents, a bank-approved introducer, and video-call verification, and rejection rates remain significant. Budget a one-day in-person visit to Panama City for the signatory and UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume micro-credits flowing from Kickstarter, Stripe, and PayPal settlement accounts with unidentified retail payers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Campaign launch report, Stripe and dashboard settlement statements, PayPal transaction histories, commercial invoices, fulfilment/order logs, product photography of the sharp-edge epoxy resin liquid-core polyhedral dice, and the HS 9504.90 tariff classification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of the private Sociedad Anónima structure with potential bearer-share risk and foreign directors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled articles of incorporation, current registered agent certificate, notarized share register, UBO declaration formally filed with the DGI under Law 254/2019, and annual validated economic substance file reflecting manufacturing activity in ISIC 3240.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Material mismatch between declared manufacturing activity and a purely e-commerce/digital sales profile with no visible production facility.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Industrial lease agreement or property utility bill, resin and mold supplier purchase orders, equipment invoices (pressure pots, resin casting tumblers, polishing tools), production floor photos/video, and a short standard operating procedure narrative for the manufacturing of dice.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sudden inbound capital injection or authorized-capital increase without traceable shareholder remittances.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board minutes approving the capital call, executed share subscription agreements, bank or exchange statements evidencing the source of funds of each investor, updated registry of shareholders, and the company's Paz y Salvo (tax clearance) from the DGI.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital is credited 1:1 in USD with no conversion. Routing: remitter sends SWIFT MT103 in USD to the Panamanian bank's correspondent in New York (e.g., BNY Mellon, JPMorgan or Citibank) for credit to the S.A.'s domestic USD account; field 70 must state 'Aporte de capital / capital injection from shareholders - subscription of shares'. Prior notice must be given to the receiving bank, supported by the notarized board resolution, updated share register, and source-of-funds documentation. Amounts above the bank's internal threshold will trigger a 48-72 hour compliance hold pending verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For settlement of resin, epoxy, liquid-core materials, molds, and freight: (i) SWIFT MT103/MT202 telegraphic transfers for supplier down-payments and balances; (ii) commercial letters of credit (sight or 30-day usance) for material purchase orders above USD 10,000; (iii) PayPal/Stripe settlement for hundreds of small digital transactions and shipping labels; and (iv) US ACH/Fedwire via the bank's New York correspondent for domestic-U.S. vendors. Every import disbursement must be matched to a Panama customs import declaration (Aduanas - Declaración de Mercancías) to satisfy trade-based money-laundering controls.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable forward contracts in EUR/USD and GBP/USD with SBP-licensed banks (no prior FX authorization required)
Plain-vanilla currency swaps (EUR/USD, GBP/USD) under an ISDA 2002 master agreement for corporates with qualified annual FX exposure
Rolling FX swap / tom-next swaps for working-capital periods without touching the 1:1 PAB-USD peg
Not available/not permissible: NDFs referencing the Balboa, because the Balboa is constitutionally pegged 1:1 to USD and a non-deliverable market cannot legally exist for PAB

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única Anual de Personas Jurídicas) payment and summary declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before 30 June of each calendar year; newly incorporated S.As pay the first-year Tasa Única at incorporation, and subsequent annual fees are due by 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a 10% surcharge plus 1% monthly interest; the Registro Público de Panamá will deny new filings and certificates of good standing while the fee remains unpaid; prolonged non-payment triggers the Registro Público inactive-company purge procedure, which may lead to administrative strike-off after formal notice and publication in the Gaceta Oficial.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Registration and Annual Confirmation (Registro de Transparencia y Beneficiarios Finales, RTBF) under Law 23 of 2023
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) RTBF electronic registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Newly incorporated entities must submit the RTBF declaration within 30 days of registration in the Public Registry; any transfer of shares triggering a change in beneficial ownership must be reported within 30 days; annual re-confirmation of beneficial ownership data is processed together with the Tasa Única filing due by 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to register or update timely is subject to fines from B/.500 to B/.5,000 per violation under Law 23 of 2023; the company also loses eligibility for tax solvency certificates and good standing certifications until the RTBF record is regularized.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Rentas, Formulario 103) or dormant-entity confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) online tax administration portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by 31 March following the close of the fiscal year (31 December); entities holding a RUC must file a zero-revenue return when no Panama-source income was generated.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers administrative fines plus interest on any assessed Panama-source tax; persistent failure to file can lead to RUC suspension, denial of solvency certificates, and impeded access to banking and payment processor validation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit applies to a Panama S.A. with annual gross revenue below B/.1,000,000 and total assets below B/.1,000,000. Mandatory audit is triggered for public-interest entities, companies regulated by the Panamanian banking or securities authorities, and taxpayers required by the DGI to present audited financial statements due to size, consolidation, or transfer pricing obligations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panama GAAP based on the Normas Internacionales de Información Financiera (NIIF/IFRS) as endorsed by the Comité de Normas de Contabilidad de Panamá; small and medium-sized entities may apply the IFRS for SMEs framework; official corporate books must be legalized in the Registro Público before use and are typically kept in Spanish.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The resident agent must maintain a sworn UBO questionnaire identifying each natural person who, directly or indirectly, holds 10% or more of shares or control. Under Law 23 of 2023, the responsible party must update the DGI RTBF portal within 30 days of any share transfer or control change. In years without changes, annual re-confirmation of the existing beneficial ownership data is processed alongside the Tasa Única payment due by 30 June.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Alternate Directors
Register of Officers and Authorized Signatories
Minute Book of Shareholders Meetings (Libro de Actas de Accionistas)
Minute Book of Board of Directors Meetings (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$250 to US$650 per year for licensed resident agent and registered office services, inclusive of Tasa Única processing and RTBF confirmation.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$0 if audit thresholds are not met; US$3,000 to US$8,000 per year if the company voluntarily commissions a certified independent audit.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial income tax: only Panamanian-source income (manufacturing of dice carried out physically in Panama, sale proceeds derived from local production) is subject to ISR; foreign-source income of the S.A. is exempt. Small-taxpayer simplified regime (ISB) available for eligible businesses with annual gross income below USD 150,000, applying 2% on gross revenue. Multinational Headquarters Regime (SEM, Law 41 of 2007) at 0% on foreign-source income for licensed SEM companies. Colón Free Zone benefits accessible only for zone-based operations. Export stimulation regimes do not generally exempt local manufacturing export revenue absent a specific statutory certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02 (Declaración Jurada del Impuesto Sobre la Renta – Personas Jurídicas), filed electronically through the DGI e-Tax online filing system (Declaración en Línea) using the RUC and the resident agent credentials.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within three (3) months after the close of the fiscal year; for calendar-year Panamanian S.As., no later than 31 March of the calendar year immediately following the fiscal year. The DGI usually publishes administrative extensions (submission extensions of 30-60 days) but the statutory date governs absent an official decree.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: RUC number of the S.A., full corporate name, fiscal year, legal representative, and resident agent reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may not file or sign the return; the Panamanian resident agent (licensed attorney or law firm) must be recorded in the Mercantile Registry and must act as the address for service for all tax filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross revenue derived from activities carried out, goods produced, or rights employed in Panama. For a dice-casting S.A., proceeds from casting, curing, packaging, and fulfilling polyhedral dice orders in Panama, irrespective of the buyer being abroad and the payment medium (Kickstarter, Stripe, PayPal), are Panamanian-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The ultimate beneficial owners cannot reclassify Panamanian manufacturing proceeds as foreign-source merely because the sales platform is offshore; all crowdfunding and marketplace settlements for dice manufactured in Panama must be booked on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income from industrial, commercial, or service activity entirely performed abroad with no utilization of Panamanian assets, labor, or rights, and income expressly exempted by law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the S.A. legitimately subcontracts a foreign factory with all casting abroad and assumes no Panamanian manufacturing activity, the corresponding export income may be treated as foreign-source; however, invoices, contracts, and customs records must substantiate the foreign location.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sum of Line 1 and Line 2. Used as the gross receipt base for the small-taxpayer threshold analysis and for sales-based surcharge calculations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The total must reconcile exactly with the amounts settled through Kickstarter, Stripe, and PayPal, net of payment processing fees if the fees are contractually borne by the S.A.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold (epoxy resin, pigments, molds, polyhedral cavities, polishing supplies, contract labor), freight, depreciation of casting equipment, rents, salaries, professional fees, and utility costs properly documented and causally connected to producing gross income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany charges for the use of molds, trademarks, or software paid to non-resident related parties must satisfy the arm's length standard; undocumented cash purchases of raw materials are universally disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 – Net Income Before Loss Offset
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 3 less Line 4, before application of net operating loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The S.A. must carry, retain, and audit-translate its ledgers into Spanish-compliant schedules; the DGI may reconstruct income using bank statements if the ledger is deemed unreliable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Losses incurred in Panamanian-source activities within the preceding five (5) fiscal years, applied to reduce the current year taxable base of the same source category.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses supported by filed prior-year returns are deductible; a non-resident parent cannot surrender its foreign tax losses to the Panamanian S.A.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 5 minus Line 6, representing the base on which the 25% corporate rate is imposed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The legal representative and the external certified public accountant must both sign; unsupported reductions of this line are the primary audit trigger in DGI ex-officio determinations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax result of applying 25% (or the applicable 2% ISB rate, where validly elected) to Line 7.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The return must be sensitive to exports; income tax is not zero merely because the S.A. earns dollars from foreign customers from cast product in Panamanian territory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 9 – Advance Payments, Withholdings, and Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for annual income tax advances (anticipos), any ITBMS withholdings, and other statutory credits previously deposited with the DGI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident lenders or foreign crowdfunding platforms do not generate withholding credits in Panama; credits must be traceable to the Panamanian S.A.'s RUC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 10 – Net Tax Payable or Credit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Definitive balance due after Line 8 less Line 9; payment via the e-Tax payment module with official receipt and should be accompanied by the sworn financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Failure to pay by the statutory deadline triggers immediate surcharge accrual; tax clearance (Paz y Salvo) is automatically blocked for the S.A.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annex TP – Transfer Pricing Disclosure Schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of all transactions with related parties, by country and by nature (sales, royalties, interest, services, cost sharing), and disclosure of the arm's length method applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the S.A. buys molds or resin from a related foreign supplier or pays management fees to non-resident shareholders, the schedule must include those flows even when no tax is due on foreign-source receipts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fine of 5% of the total tax due, with a minimum of USD 100; late payment surcharge of 10% of the unpaid tax for the first month or fraction and 1% per additional month, plus monthly interest (currently at 0.75% per month, compounded). The S.A. is barred from obtaining Paz y Salvo, cannot renew municipal and registry permits, and may face a strike-off proceeding before the Mercantile Registry after sustained noncompliance.
